description.value: Lakeview Motel is a family-owned, year-round property on Highway 3 (Crowsnest Hwy) in Christina Lake, BC, in the Kootenay Boundary region. The 12 recently renovated rooms include seven fully equipped kitchen units, and the grounds feature a shared barbecue and fire pit under a log gazebo — good for swapping stories with fellow travelers. The motel sits five minutes on foot from one of Canada's warmest lakes and 1 km from the Trans Canada Trail, making it a convenient staging point for cyclists exploring the Boundary country.

address.value: 1658 Hwy 3, Christina Lake, British Columbia V0H 1E3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the motel is open 365 days per year at 1658 Hwy 3, Christina Lake, with all contact details matching OSM (phone, email, address). All 12 rooms include high-speed Wi-Fi per the rooms page, corroborating OSM's internet_access=wlan/fee=no tags. No mention of bike storage, laundry, tools, or e-bike charging appears anywhere on the site; the explore page explicitly states the town has no grocery store, and the rooms page confirms nearby coffee shops and restaurants within one block.
concerns: OSM address field ('1658 Crowsnest Highway') omits city, province, and postal code; full address used from website ('1658 Hwy 3, Christina Lake, BC V0H 1E3').
Contact page notes that Google Maps sometimes directs EV drivers to charge across the highway — no on-site EV or e-bike charging infrastructure is mentioned.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel operating year-round on Highway 3 at Christina Lake, with an active website and confirmed contact details.
